description_en: Downgrades an instance group. Currently, this operation allows you to only delete specific cloud phone instances from an instance group
description_zh: 降级实例组。目前仅支持释放实例组中的指定实例
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic downgrade-android-instance-group --instance-group-id ag-cuv4scs4obxhs0000 --android-instance-ids acp-hangzhouarmw0000 --auto-pay true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DowngradeAndroidInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group
parameters.name: instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the cloud phone instances that you want to delete
parameters.name: android_instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the auto-payment feature. Default value: false.

Valid values:

true: enables the auto-payment feature. Ensure your account has sufficient balance to use this feature.
false: disables the auto-payment feature. This requires manual payment each time you place an order
parameters.name: auto_pay
